intent: Regenerate a new first-party synthetic edge-case cohort under the qualified provider route if the historical creator receipt for the old cohort cannot be recovered.

scope.matrix: 10 hardcoded edge families x 3 difficulty levels x 4 ambiguity patterns

provider_route.use: Generate and fine-tune only within W&B research SFT under the reviewed terms; no transfer to Fireworks or Adaption.

run_receipt_fields: provider-reported usage and model label when returned
new_generation_provenance.resume_policy: Reject existing output without a receipt or any provider/model/source/code/config fingerprint mismatch.

pre_execution_gates: Process-only credential use is user-authorized; this plan has no inference budget authorization. Obtain a distinct explicit cap before any generation call.
Estimate request count and worst-case inference cost for the full transcript; do not assume record limit bounds completion calls. Obtain the distinct explicit cap before generation.
Confirm output directory is new/private and the W&B training service remains the only downstream destination.
After generation, machine acceptance, PII/source checks, heldout group overlap, split disjointness and payload hashes must pass before any draft release can be considered.
No generation until source/seed rights and privacy scope are cleared and provider terms permit this use.
limitations: This is a new cohort and is not a clearance or replacement for historical candidate rows. Historical edge outputs remain unresolved until their exact provider/model receipt and applicable terms are established.
